answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a scarce bond earned only by burning real external compute, then have random peers continuously audit the work behind it. Picture the bond as a echo, the audited work-trail as a forge, and the protected reward pool as a haven: to run N fake identities an attacker must fund N separate echos, sustain N forges of genuine audited effort, and defend N havens, so cost scales linearly per head while one honest agent pays the toll a single time.
